vo.text: Your phone does not need to remember a perfect photograph of your finger.
vo.speak: Your phone does not need to remember a perfect photograph of your finger.

vo.text: It learns a pattern of distinguishing details.
vo.speak: It learns a pattern of distinguishing details.

vo.text: Many phones use a capacitive sensor to read ridges and valleys.
vo.speak: Many phones use a capacitive sensor to read ridges and valleys.

vo.text: Tiny electrical differences help map where each ridge sits.
vo.speak: Tiny electrical differences help map where each ridge sits.

vo.text: The system finds features such as ridge endings and splits.
vo.speak: The system finds features such as ridge endings and splits.

vo.text: It stores a mathematical template, not an ordinary image you can open.
vo.speak: It stores a mathematical template, not an ordinary image you can open.

vo.text: When you try again, the new scan becomes another template.
vo.speak: When you try again, the new scan becomes another template.

vo.text: The phone compares features and their positions, allowing for small shifts.
vo.speak: The phone compares features and their positions, allowing for small shifts.

vo.text: A close match unlocks; a poor match fails.
vo.speak: A close match unlocks; a poor match fails.

vo.text: So your fingerprint becomes a pattern the phone can compare without expecting two touches to be identical.
vo.speak: So your fingerprint becomes a pattern the phone can compare without expecting two touches to be identical.
